inputs.checklistItemText: Grading plan shows drainage slopes toward building from oil-filled transformer pad location (liquid flow must be away from building)
inputs.question: On the grading plan, what are the contour line elevations around each transformer pad? Is the slope of the ground directed away from or toward any buildings? Are the transformers identified as oil-filled equipment?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking for label readout (contour elevations, transformer identification) and visual feature presence/orientation (slope direction, building proximity), not a quantitative distance or clearance measurement between two points.
